seo.title: Bureau | Process Engine for Melusina
seo.description: Define processes with their own datasets, AI models, and automation rules. Every instance runs in isolation with its own documents and data. Managers track everything on a Kanban board.

hero.heading: One process definition. Thousands of isolated instances.
hero.subtitle: Define as many process templates as your organization needs—client onboarding, vendor assessment, loan approval, incident reporting. Each process has its own stages, datasets, AI calls, and access controls. Each instance runs in its own Pearl. Managers see their processes on Kanban boards. Interlink processes when one feeds into another.

concepts.heading: Process definitions vs process instances
concepts.intro: Bureau separates what you design from what runs. This is the key to true isolation.

items.title: Process Templates
items.description: Create as many process types as your organization needs: KYC for individuals, KYB for companies, vendor onboarding, loan applications, compliance reviews. Each template defines its stages, forms, required documents, AI checks, and automation rules. Different templates can be managed by different teams.

items.title: Process Instances
items.description: When someone starts a process, Melusina creates a new Pearl—a fresh Linux container just for that instance. All documents, AI results, and datasets stay inside. One client's data never touches another's. Delete the instance—everything goes with it. Export it—everything comes out.

items.title: Interlinked Processes
items.description: Processes can spawn other processes. Complete a KYC? It can trigger a periodic review process in 12 months. Approve a vendor? Spawn a contract workflow. Link instances together while keeping each isolated. Parent-child relationships, sequential handoffs, parallel branches.

access.heading: Different processes, different teams
access.description: Each process template can have its own managers and its own pool of users. Your compliance team manages KYC. Your procurement team manages vendor onboarding. Your HR manages employee requests. They each see only their Kanban boards, only their instances, only their data.

capabilities.title: Process-level permissions
capabilities.description: Assign which users can create new instances, which can review, which can approve. Role-based access at the process template level.

capabilities.title: Instance-level access
capabilities.description: Each instance can have its own participants: the submitter, assigned reviewers, external parties via secure links. Access is enforced by the Pearl.

capabilities.title: Cross-process visibility
capabilities.description: Executives can see dashboards across all processes. Analysts can run reports. But they enter each instance through its Pearl—no backdoor access.

ai.heading: Intelligence at every step
ai.intro: AI isn't bolted on—it's woven into the process fabric. Every AI call runs inside the instance's Pearl, using your models, on your data.

items.title: Document OCR
items.description: Upload a passport, driver's license, utility bill, or corporate document. AI extracts structured data: name, date of birth, address, document number, expiry date. Users review and correct. All inside the Pearl.

items.title: Face Recognition & Liveness
items.description: Capture a selfie. Compare it to the photo on the ID document. Run liveness detection to prevent spoofing. AI returns a confidence score. All processing happens inside the instance—no face data leaves.

items.title: Sanity Check Before Submit
items.description: Before the user clicks 'Submit', AI reviews the entire form. Does the name on the ID match the typed name? Is the address consistent? Are dates valid? Surface warnings so users can fix errors before submission.

items.title: Dynamic Risk Scoring
items.description: As data comes in, AI recalculates risk: high-risk jurisdiction, PEP status, unusual source of funds, sanctions matches. Risk score updates in real-time. Thresholds trigger additional requirements or escalations.

items.title: Document Requirement Matrix
items.description: Different clients need different documents. AI evaluates: entity type + jurisdiction + risk level + source of funds = required document set. A high-risk trust from a non-cooperative jurisdiction needs more proof than a low-risk individual from a treaty country.

items.title: Entity Extraction
items.description: Upload contracts, financial statements, or corporate filings. AI extracts entities: company names, officer names, dates, amounts, obligations. Populate your datasets automatically.

kyc.heading: Full KYC, KYB, and beyond
kyc.intro: Bureau isn't a generic form builder that happens to do compliance. It's built for identity verification and regulatory workflows from day one.

items.title: KYC — Know Your Customer
items.description: Individual identity verification: collect government ID, proof of address, source of funds. OCR extracts data. Face matching confirms identity. PEP and sanctions screening. Risk scoring. All in one flow, one Pearl, one audit trail.

items.title: KYB — Know Your Business
items.description: Corporate verification: company registration, beneficial ownership, director identification, UBO declarations. Nested forms for shareholders. Percentage validation on ownership. Corporate structure diagrams built from data.

items.title: EDD — Enhanced Due Diligence
items.description: When risk thresholds trigger, the process automatically requests additional documentation: source of wealth narrative, bank statements, reference letters, site visits. Dynamic requirements based on risk profile.

items.title: Periodic Reviews
items.description: Compliance doesn't end at onboarding. Schedule periodic reviews: annual refresh, risk-triggered re-verification, event-driven updates. Spawn a new process instance linked to the original.

items.title: Sanctions & PEP Screening
items.description: Integrate with screening providers or run your own lists. Check at submission, check periodically, check on data changes. Hits surface in the case for human review.

items.title: Audit Trail & Evidence Export
items.description: Every action logged: who submitted, who reviewed, what changed, when approved. Export the complete evidence package for regulators: documents, data, decisions, timestamps. One click.

items.title: Dedicated datasets
items.description: Each process template declares its data schema: person records, company records, shareholder tables, document metadata. Every instance gets its own copy—no shared database, no row-level security hacks.

items.title: Multi-step wizards
items.description: Break complex processes into panels. Progress tracking. Can't proceed until current panel validates. Navigation forward and back. State persists across sessions. Users can save and resume.

items.title: Automation rules
items.description: Write rules in JSONLogic: 'If jurisdiction is high-risk AND source of funds is crypto, require enhanced due diligence.' Rules execute per-instance. Trigger stage transitions, spawn linked processes, send notifications.

items.title: Document storage
items.description: PDFs, images, signed contracts—each instance stores its own files inside its Pearl. Not in a shared bucket with path prefixes. Delete the instance, files go with it. Export the instance, everything comes out.

items.title: Secure external links
items.description: Share an instance with a client via a secure link—they see only their Pearl. Set expiration, password protection, allowed actions. Track when they access. Revoke instantly.

items.title: Notifications & reminders
items.description: Email, SMS, in-app—notify participants at stage transitions, approaching deadlines, or data changes. Templates with merge fields. Delivery tracking inside the audit log.

kanban.heading: Kanban board across all instances
kanban.description: Your team needs to see the big picture. Bureau gives managers a unified view of every running instance—while maintaining isolation underneath.

capabilities.title: Columns = Stages
capabilities.description: Each column is a process stage you defined: New, In Progress, Awaiting Documents, Under Review, Approved, Rejected. Instances appear as cards with key data visible.

capabilities.title: Drag to transition
capabilities.description: Move a card from 'Under Review' to 'Approved'. Bureau updates the instance state, logs the transition, triggers automation rules, sends notifications.

capabilities.title: Filter and search
capabilities.description: Filter by assignee, date range, risk score, entity type, jurisdiction. Full-text search across instance data. Find the cases that need attention.

capabilities.title: Click to enter
capabilities.description: Click any card to open that instance's Pearl. You're now inside that client's isolated container. See their documents, data, AI results—and only theirs.

capabilities.title: Bulk operations
capabilities.description: Select multiple cards, assign to a team member, add tags, export as evidence packages, trigger batch actions. Operations run on each Pearl individually.

capabilities.title: SLA & deadline tracking
capabilities.description: Set time limits per stage. Cards turn yellow at 75%, red at 100%. Never miss a regulatory deadline. Escalation rules auto-assign or notify supervisors.

fieldTypes.heading: 44+ field types to capture any data
fieldTypes.intro: Every field type is designed for compliance and usability. Mobile-friendly, accessible, with built-in validation.

fields.name: File Upload
fields.desc: Any file type with size limits

items.title: Individual KYC
items.description: Collect ID, proof of address, source of funds. OCR extracts data. Face matching verifies identity. Sanctions screening runs automatically. Risk score determines if EDD is needed. Manager approves on Kanban.

items.title: Corporate KYB
items.description: Company registration, articles of incorporation, beneficial ownership. Nested forms for each UBO. Percentage validation on ownership. Corporate structure built from data. Each company is its own Pearl.

items.title: Vendor Onboarding
items.description: Send a portal link. Vendor fills questionnaire, uploads certifications, signs terms. AI extracts key dates and obligations. You see all vendors on Kanban. Each vendor isolated from others.

items.title: Loan Applications
items.description: Applicant submits financials, uploads bank statements, authorizes credit check. AI extracts income and liabilities. Underwriters review on Kanban. Approved applications spawn disbursement process.

items.title: Periodic Reviews
items.description: Scheduled re-verification at 12-month intervals. System spawns a review instance linked to original KYC. Client updates changed information. Delta highlighted for reviewer.

items.title: Incident Management
items.description: Staff report incidents with details and evidence. Investigators assigned. Escalation paths defined. Each incident isolated—even sensitive cases stay compartmentalized from others.

cta.heading: Define your first process
cta.subtitle: See how a process goes from template to running instances. Watch AI extract documents, score risk, and surface issues—while each client's data stays in its own Pearl.
